items.name: LVM: data raw
items.description:
Collects LVM storage information from the monitored Linux host using the pvs, lvs and vgs commands.

Returns a consolidated JSON document containing three datasets:

- Physical Volumes (PVs)
- Logical Volumes (LVs)
- Volume Groups (VGs)

Collected information includes device paths, volume relationships, metadata formats, attributes, allocation status, capacity, available space, UUIDs and Logical Volume properties.

discovery_rules.name: LVM: Logical volumes discovery
discovery_rules.description:
Discovers all LVM physical volumes available on the monitored host.

Returns physical volume information using the following LLD macros:
{#LVM_PV} - Physical volume device path.
{#LVM_VG} - Associated volume group name.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}][{#LVM_LV}] Logical volume active
item_prototypes.description:
Indicates whether the Logical Volume is currently active.

Possible values:
0 - INACTIVE
1 - ACTIVE
2 - UNKNOWN

Based on the activation flag in the LV attribute string.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}][{#LVM_LV}] Logical volume attributes
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the raw LVM attribute string of the Logical Volume (LV).

The attribute string contains information about the Logical Volume type, permissions, allocation, activation and open status.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}][{#LVM_LV}] Logical volume open
item_prototypes.description:
Indicates whether the Logical Volume is currently open and in use by the system.

Possible values:
0 - CLOSED
1 - OPEN
2 - UNKNOWN

Based on the open flag in the LV attribute string.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}][{#LVM_LV}] Logical volume origin
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the name of the origin Logical Volume associated with the current Logical Volume.

Returns an empty value if the Logical Volume does not have an associated origin.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}][{#LVM_LV}] Logical volume size
item_prototypes.description: Returns the total allocated size of the Logical Volume in bytes.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}][{#LVM_LV}] Logical volume type
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the Logical Volume type code extracted from the LV attribute string.

The type code represents the Logical Volume type according to the LVM attribute format.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}][{#LVM_LV}] Logical volume writable
item_prototypes.description:
Indicates whether the Logical Volume allows write operations.

Possible values:
0 - READ ONLY
1 - WRITABLE
2 - UNKNOWN

Based on the permissions flag in the LV attribute string.

discovery_rules.name: LVM: Physical volume discovery
discovery_rules.description:
Discovers all LVM physical volumes available on the monitored host.

Returns physical volume information using the following LLD macros:
{#LVM_PV} - Physical volume device path.
{#LVM_VG} - Associated volume group name.
{#LVM_PV_UUID} - Physical volume UUID.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_PV}] Physical volume allocatable
item_prototypes.description:
Indicates whether the Physical Volume is available for Logical Volume allocation.

Possible values:
0 - NOT ALLOCATABLE
1 - ALLOCATABLE
2 - UNKNOWN

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_PV}] Physical volume attributes
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the raw LVM attribute string of the Physical Volume.

The attribute string contains information about the PV status and allocation properties.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_PV}] Physical volume format
item_prototypes.description: Returns the metadata format used by the Physical Volume.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_PV}] Physical volume free space
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the amount of unallocated space available on the Physical Volume in bytes.

Represents free Physical Volume extents available for allocation within the associated Volume Group.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_PV}] Physical volume UUID
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) assigned to the Physical Volume.

The UUID uniquely identifies the Physical Volume independently of its device path.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_PV}] Physical volume size
item_prototypes.description: Returns the total capacity of the Physical Volume in bytes.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_PV}] Associated volume group
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the name of the Volume Group (VG) associated with the Physical Volume (PV).

Returns an empty value if the Physical Volume is not assigned to any Volume Group.

discovery_rules.name: LVM: Volume group discovery
discovery_rules.description:
Discovers all LVM physical volumes available on the monitored host.

Returns physical volume information using the following LLD macros:
{#LVM_PV} - Physical volume device path.
{#LVM_VG} - Associated volume group name.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}] Volume group attributes
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the raw LVM attribute string of the Volume Group (VG).

The attribute string contains information about the Volume Group status, permissions and configuration properties.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}] Volume group free space
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the amount of unallocated storage space available in the Volume Group in bytes.

Represents free Physical Volume extents that can be allocated to Logical Volumes.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}] Volume group resizable
item_prototypes.description:
Indicates whether the Volume Group supports resizing operations.

Possible values:
0 - NOT RESIZABLE
1 - RESIZABLE
2 - UNKNOWN

Based on the resize flag in the VG attribute string.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}] Volume group size
item_prototypes.description:
Returns the total capacity of the Volume Group in bytes.

The value represents the total storage capacity provided by all Physical Volumes assigned to the Volume Group.

item_prototypes.name: LVM: [{#LVM_VG}] Volume group writable
item_prototypes.description:
Indicates whether the Volume Group allows write operations.

Possible values:
0 - READ ONLY
1 - WRITABLE
2 - UNKNOWN

Based on the permissions flag in the VG attribute string.
